characters.note: As the topic particle, は is pronounced wa.
As a direction particle, へ is pronounced e.
The object particle を is normally pronounced o.
Rare outside special contexts; usually pronounced o.
Pause briefly before the next consonant; this is not a full tsu syllable.
Often a long o, depending on the word.
Often a long e; careful speech may retain ei.
